title: Phrase-Level Adversarial Training for Mitigating Bias in Neural Network-based Automatic Essay Scoring

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating automatic essay scoring (AES) models' over-reliance on the most represented data samples and specific lexical patterns by generating phrase-level adversarial essays (using TF-IDF phrase extraction, blank-infilling, and label-preserving filters) and measuring the drop in the models' classification accuracy when exposed to these perturbed examples.
